thread:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: Dedicated reserved pool 'resv-nyc-01' GPU utilization at 99.9% and queue length growing (5000 reqs). Autoscaler attempted scale but hit configured max_replicas=6. Potential noisy-tenant activity detected. Paging oncall rotation.

maria.garcia: acked. jumping in - paging @ashwin who owns resv autoscaler flapping. any immediate customer-facing impact?

ashwin: seeing elevated 429s and request latency for several enterprise reservations. KestrelHealth (tenant:kestrel-prod) showing ~30% failed requests last 5m. throttles returned by reservation gateway.

jake: on it. grabbing dashboard: https://console/redwood/d/pools/resv-nyc-01?from=now-30m to=now - CPU/GPU pinned at 100%. autoscaler events show repeated `ScaleUp: blocked (max replicas)` since 2954320789.

sophia: support reports customer Slack thread from Kestrel: "we're seeing timeouts during nightly billing runs" — they say this started ~ 40m ago. CC: @customer-success.

infra-lead: quick triage - is this autoscaler limit expected? config shows max_replicas=6 for this pool because it's reserved capacity. Could increase but need control-plane signoff.

ashwin: we have two issues: 1) noisy-unbounded dev tenant 'triad-sandbox' consuming many long-running generation sessions, and 2) autoscaler refused burst because burst_capacity flag false on reserved pools. both together caused queue growth.

maria.garcia: suggested mitigation timeline: immediate short-term (evict/scale down noisy tenant), mid-term (enable burst_capacity or raise max_replicas), longer-term (rate-limit long-running sessions per tenant).

jake: running eviction command now to drain low-priority reservations (evict policy: best-effort, respect contracts):
```bash
# evict dev sandbox sessions
redwood ctl evict --pool resv-nyc-01 --tenant triad-sandbox --grace 30s --force
```

incident-bot: ACTION_STARTED: evict triad-sandbox initiated by jake at 2954321500.

ashwin: eviction progressing, freed ~2 GPUs worth of load, queue length down ~25%. However Kestrel still seeing errors — likely their tasks are queued and timing out.

support: we posted initial update to Kestrel: "We're actively mitigating — evicting noisy sessions and adding capacity. Will update in 10m."

maria.garcia: can we temporarily route Kestrel to hosted fallback (non-reserved) until we stabilize? their SLA allows fallback for short window.

ashwin: we can, but need tenant routing change and an API key mapping. doing staged reroute: set route override for tenant:kestrel-prod to 'hosted-llm-highmem' with lower concurrency.

jake: applied route override at 2954321822. Kestrel traffic now split 70/30 to hosted. they report drop in errors to ~6% (was 30%).

sophia: good. note: hosted will increase per-token cost for them — flagged with CS.

infra-lead: root cause notes to capture: reserved-pool autoscaler max_replicas too conservative for bursty nightly jobs + lack of burst_capacity allowed for reserved pools + a noisy sandbox tenant holding long KV-cache-backed sessions. Also autoscaler does not currently consider per-tenant concurrency quotas when deciding eviction targets.

ashwin: also saw several 403s from cloud API when trying to request additional nodes between 2954321000-2954321200. looks like short-lived IAM token rotation bug; scaled attempts failed, so autoscaler aborted some scaleups. opened infra ticket.

maria.garcia: immediate permanent mitigations planned: 1) enable burst_capacity on resv-nyc-01 for the next 6h, 2) raise max_replicas to 8 for critical reserved pools, 3) patch autoscaler to retry scale requests on transient cloud errors. need approvals for capacity bump.

incident-bot: APPROVAL_REQUEST: capacity bump (resv-nyc-01 +2 GPUs / max_replicas=8) requested by maria.garcia. Approvers: infra-lead, eng-ops.

infra-lead: approve. we have spare on-prem quota. do it.

jake: applying capacity bump now: `redwood ctl pool update resv-nyc-01 --max-replicas 8 --enable-burst true`

incident-bot: ACTION_COMPLETED: pool update applied at 2954322200. New max_replicas=8, burst_capacity=true.

ashwin: autoscaler triggered additional two instances; GPU util dropped to 72% over 10m. queue drained. Kestrel errors back to baseline.

support: notified Kestrel of mitigation and routing change reversal plan. CS will follow up with cost note and postmortem invite.

maria.garcia: summary for timeline to include in incident ticket: detection by capacity alert -> eviction of noisy tenant -> route override to hosted fallback -> capacity bump + burst enable -> autoscaler succeeded after transient cloud API fix -> restore routing -> monitor.

sophia: creating postmortem ticket and assigning P0 to eng-sre and infra for follow-ups. link: https://issues/redwood/INC-295432

incident-bot: HANDOFF: on-call rotation handing to next oncall @ashwin for 4h monitoring window. Please ensure dashboards stable and handoff note in #eng-sre.

ashwin: acknowledged. I'll keep a 2h watch and then pass to daytime team. leaving note: throttle rule to be added to rate-limiter for long-running sessions.

maria.garcia: good work team. follow-ups: (1) autoscaler retry patch, (2) per-tenant long-session quotas, (3) review reserved pool max defaults and burst policy, (4) investigate IAM token rotation causing transient scale failures.

support: Kestrel CS notified and will run an after-action call tomorrow.

incident-bot: THREAD_CLOSED: incident mitigated and under monitoring. Final status: degraded -> mitigated.
